author: nickyeow

english.text: This sticky liquid can be substituted for glue.

jyutping: ni1 di1 nim1 jik6 ho2 ji5 dong1 gaau1 seoi2 jung6。
text: 呢啲黏液可以當膠水用。

author: nihtscua

english.text: Happy birthday, Muriel!

jyutping: saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6，Muriel!
text: 生日快樂，Muriel!

author: nickyeow

english.text: What's the good of having a car if you don't drive?

jyutping: nei5 dou1 m4 zaa1 ce1，jiu3 gaa3 ce1 lai4 zou6 me1 ze1？
text: 你都唔揸車，要架車嚟做咩啫？

author: nickyeow

english.text: It is necessary for you to help her.

jyutping: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 bong1 haa5 keoi5。
text: 你一定要幫吓佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How long does it take to walk from here to the station?

jyutping: hai2 ni1 dou6 haang4 dou3 heoi3 ce1 zaam6 jiu3 gei2 noi6 gaa3？
text: 喺呢度行到去車站要幾耐㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: As soon as she read the letter, she began to cry.

jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoi1 ci2 duk6 go2 fung1 seon3 zau6 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4。
text: 佢一開始讀嗰封信就喊咗出嚟。

author: nickyeow

english.text: May I help you?

jyutping: jau5 me1 bong1 dou3 nei5 ne1？
text: 有咩幫到你呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I won't lose!

jyutping: ngo5 m4 wui5 syu1 ge3！
text: 我唔會輸嘅！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Get your mother to do your homework!

jyutping: giu3 nei5 aa3 maa1 bong1 nei5 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1！
text: 叫你阿媽幫你做功課啦！

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: I am not gay, but my boyfriend is.
I'm not gay, but my boyfriend is.
I am not a comrade, however my boyfriend is.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 tung4 zi3，bat1 gwo3 ngo5 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5 hai6。
text: 我唔係同志，不過我個男朋友係。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He promised to see about my broken watch.

jyutping: keoi5 jing1 sing4 zo2 ngo5 waa6 bong1 ngo5 tai2 haa5 ngo5 zek3 waai6 zo2 ge3 sau2 biu1。
text: 佢應承咗我話幫我睇吓我隻壞咗嘅手錶。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Could you turn down the radio?

jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 gaau3 sai3 seng1 siu2 siu2 aa3？
text: 可唔可以將部收音機較細聲少少呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If we don't receive Tom's reply within the next three days, I think we should write him again.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 aa3 Tom lai4 gan2 ne1 saam1 jat6 dou1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 dei6，ngo5 nam2 ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 se2 do1 fung1 seon3 bei2 keoi5。
text: 如果阿Tom嚟緊呢三日都唔覆我哋，我諗我哋應該寫多封信俾佢。

author: fercheung

english.text: German is not as difficult as Icelandic.

jyutping: dak1 man4 mou5 bing1 dou2 man4 gam3 naan4。
text: 德文冇冰島文咁難。

author: sgmw

english.text: This is the best time of year.

jyutping: cyun4 nin4 zeoi3 zeng3 zau6 hai6 ni1 go3 si4 hau6。
text: 全年最正就係呢個時候。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Friends today, enemies tomorrow.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 ge3 pang4 jau5 hai6 ting1 jat6 ge3 dik6 jan4。
text: 今日嘅朋友係聽日嘅敵人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Give me your word that you won't do that.

jyutping: jing1 sing4 ngo5 nei5 m4 wui5 gam3 zou6。
text: 應承我你唔會咁做。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let go of him!

jyutping: fong3 hoi1 keoi5！
text: 放開佢！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can you read music?

jyutping: nei5 sik1 m4 sik1 tai2 pou2 gaa3？
text: 你識唔識睇譜㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He, just like you, is a good golfer.

jyutping: keoi5 tung4 nei5 jat1 joeng6，daa2 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4 dou1 hou2 ging6。
text: 佢同你一樣，打哥爾夫球都好勁。

author: nickyeow

english.text: See, that wasn't so difficult, was it?

jyutping: hai6 mai6 aa3，dou1 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 gam3 naan4 ze1？
text: 係咪呀，都唔係真係咁難啫？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will the experiment succeed?

jyutping: sat6 jim6 wui5 m4 wui5 sing4 gung1 ne1？
text: 實驗會唔會成功呢？

author: nickyeow

english.text: You should assume that email messages aren't private.

jyutping: nei5 jing1 goi1 dong1 zo2 nei5 di1 din6 jau4 hai6 wui5 bei2 jan4 tai2 dou2 ge3 sin1。
text: 你應該當咗你啲電郵係會俾人睇到嘅先。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why haven't you replied to me for so long?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei5 gam3 noi6 dou1 m4 fuk1 ngo5 ge3？
text: 點解你咁耐都唔覆我嘅？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I don't like this cartoon.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 tou3 kaa1 tung1。
text: 我唔鍾意呢套卡通。

author: Matthewyau1367

english.text: Some of the rivers that feed the bay have American Indian names like Potomac, Susquehanna and Rappahannock. The bay supported native societies for thousands of years. The name Chesapeake comes from an Algonquin Indian word often defined as "great shellfish bay."

jyutping: jau5 di1 ho4 lau4 jau5 mei5 zau1 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4 ge3 ming4，lai6 jyu4 bo1 tok3 maa5 hak1、sou1 si1 hak1 hon3 naap6 tung4 laai1 paak3 hon3 nok6 hak1，nei1 go3 hoi2 waan1 zi1 ci4 zo2 jyun4 zyu6 man4 se5 wui2 gei2 cin1 nin4。cit3 saat3 pei4 hak1 nei1 go3 ming4 hai6 lai4 zi6 jat1 go3 aa3 gong1 kwan1 jan3 dai6 on1 jan4 ge3 ci4 jyu5，tung1 soeng4 bei6 ding6 ji6 wai4「wai5 daai6 ge3 bui3 leoi6 waan1」。
text: 有啲河流有美洲印第安人嘅名，例如波托馬克、蘇斯克漢納同拉帕漢諾克，呢個海灣支持咗原住民社會幾千年。切薩皮克呢個名係嚟自一個阿岡昆印第安人嘅詞語，通常被定義為「偉大嘅貝類灣」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Jai, my East Indian friend, and I preferred to lunch or dine at a Japanese restaurant. Jai was multilingual and knew several East Indian languages. He knew some German, as he tried to speak to his daughters in this language. He met his wife Erika in Germany, when he was working there. Before, he had also a stint in Thailand.

jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 dung1 jan3 dou6 pang4 jau5 Jai bei2 gaau3 zung1 ji3 hai2 jat6 bun2 caan1 teng1 sik6 ng5 caan1 waak6 ze2 sik6 faan6。 Jai hai6 do1 jyu5 jin4 ge3 jan4，sik1 gei2 zung2 dung1 jan3 dou6 jyu5 jin4。keoi5 sik1 di1 dak1 man2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 si3 gwo3 jung6 ni1 zung2 jyu5 jin4 tung4 keoi5 di1 neoi5 gong2 je5。keoi5 hai2 dak1 gwok3 sik1 zo2 keoi5 lou5 po4 Erika ，dong1 si4 keoi5 hai2 dak1 gwok3 gung1 zok3 gan2。zi1 cin4，keoi5 jik6 dou1 hai2 taai3 gwok3 dou6 gwo3 zo2 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3。
text: 我同我嘅東印度朋友 Jai 比較鍾意喺日本餐廳食午餐或者食飯。 Jai 係多語言嘅人，識幾種東印度語言。佢識啲德文，因為佢試過用呢種語言同佢啲女講嘢。佢喺德國識咗佢老婆 Erika ，當時佢喺德國工作緊。之前，佢亦都喺泰國度過咗一段時間。
